verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.

verses.he: בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness, Thou who didst set me free when I was in distress; Be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.

verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be put to shame, In that ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah

verses.he: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.en: But know that the LORD hath set apart the godly man as His own; The LORD will hear when I call unto Him.

verses.he: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Tremble, and sin not; Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the LORD. .

verses.he: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֪נוּ֫ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Many there are that say: 'Oh that we could see some good!' LORD, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.

verses.he: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃
verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than when their corn and their wine increase.

verses.he: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For Thou, LORD, makest me dwell alone in safety.
